analyst_view.overall: Fran Escribá's Real Valladolid (12th, 19 points) host Real Sociedad B (19th, 13 points, in the drop zone) at Zorrilla on Saturday night, with Valladolid favourites. The Sanse lose Álex Marchal and Gorka Carrera, two of their front three, to bans after the 0-3 home defeat to Cádiz (counted by the numbers), and EFE's list also has Iñaki Rupérez banned for yellow cards, which the numbers do not count. Valladolid's striker Juanmi Latasa is now confirmed back: Escribá said he is 'perfect' and trained well, and the club says he has rejoined the group, while the numbers still take him out (-7.6% on Valladolid's goals). Trilli (adductor) and Guille Bueno (not registered until January) are out; Escribá says he will play his best side here despite the Copa derby against Zamora on Wednesday. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, 1.5 for Valladolid, after taking 7.6% off their goals for Latasa and 6.8% off the Sanse's for Carrera's ban. Two sources now say Latasa is fit and trained fully, so that deduction is out of date; he may not play the whole game after injury, so I give back most of it, +4% on the total, about 2.6. The Sanse's extra absence, Rupérez, does not suggest they will score more.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners, 6.0 for Valladolid, already raised for both sides' busy recent corner counts (40 for Valladolid in six). Escribá wants a pressing side that makes the Sanse uncomfortable, which fits how the numbers already see the game, so I stay at about 9.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.0 cards, raised a little for the Sanse's recent bookings, including the two second-yellow reds against Cádiz and Rupérez's fifth yellow. A young side fighting relegation away from home can pick up cards, but the numbers already see their record and no referee is named, so I stay at about 6.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.7 shots, already lifted 14% for the Sanse's busy recent shooting against a Valladolid defence that has let opponents shoot a lot (93 in six). Without Marchal and Carrera the Sanse front line is weaker, but both bans are counted, and Latasa's return changes who shoots for Valladolid more than how often, so I stay at about 28.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target, already raised for Valladolid's sharp recent shooting (40 on target in six). With Latasa, their first-choice striker, confirmed fit after missing the Celta Fortuna game, I add a little, +3%, about 9.4.
